name: Serik Vane
seed: To control the passages between the floating islands and sell protection from his own crews.
design: Slate-gray bat, burgundy wing membranes, long black flight coat, amber scarf and hook-ended cargo pole.
history: Former rescue captain expelled after turning a weather emergency into a ransom negotiation.
desire: To control the passages between the floating islands and sell protection from his own crews.
contradiction: Needs to be admired as a rescuer while arranging circumstances that require rescue.
relationships: Eri refuses him; Vessa sells occasional observations; Brakka is a distant transactional contact, never a subordinate.
arc: Loses the flattering story when freed captives testify. His tactical skill remains real and makes pursuit difficult.
story_engine: A rescue beacon is genuine but its owner dangerous; his lieutenant must choose between saved passengers and the captain’s share.
writer_truth: He cannot create storms, control liftstone fields or command every sky pirate.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
